# Aspect ratio

Keeps an image or video at a fixed shape while the layout resizes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Aspect ratio is a media component. Accessible first's components answer takes core families only, because forms, steps and feedback are all a public service needs. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Media in cards, galleries and heroes that must not stretch or jump while it loads.
- **Not when:** Text content, or media that should keep its own natural shape.

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): The placeholder shown while the media loads.

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add aspect-ratio
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
